output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minted, the balanceOf target address is increased without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be arbitrarily increased, resulting in a decrease in the balance of the owner.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] is increased, if _to is 0, it will cause overflow, making balanceOf[_to] to be a large number, and allowing attackers to steal funds.
The transferFrom function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The _value is increased before the check, allowing attackers to transfer arbitrary amount of tokens.
